    await alip.sendMessage(m.chat, {
        react: {
            text: "🚀",
            key: m.key
        }
    })
    const os = require("os")
    const { execSync } = require("child_process")

    const used = process.memoryUsage()
    const cpus = os.cpus()

    const totalMem = os.totalmem()
    const freeMem = os.freemem()
    const usedMem = totalMem - freeMem

    let timestamp = speed()
    let latensi = speed() - timestamp

    let diskInfo = {
        total: "-",
        used: "-",
        free: "-",
        percent: 0
    }

    try {
        const raw = execSync("df -h --total | tail -n 1")
            .toString()
            .trim()
            .split(/\s+/)

        diskInfo = {
            total: raw[1] || "-",
            used: raw[2] || "-",
            free: raw[3] || "-",
            percent: parseInt(raw[4]) || 0
        }
    } catch {}

    let cpuUsage = 0

    cpus.forEach(cpu => {
        const total = Object.values(cpu.times)
            .reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0)

        cpuUsage += ((total - cpu.times.idle) / total) * 100
    })

    const cpuPercent = (cpuUsage / cpus.length).toFixed(1)
    const memPercent = ((usedMem / totalMem) * 100).toFixed(1)

    const formatBytes = bytes => {
        if (!bytes) return "0 B"
        const k = 1024
        const sizes = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB", "TB"]
        const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k))
        return (bytes / Math.pow(k, i)).toFixed(1) + " " + sizes[i]
    }

    const MB = require("baileys-mbuilder")

const ai = new MB.AIRich(alip)

    ai
    .addTable([
        ["Metric", "Value"],
        ["Latency", `${latensi.toFixed(2)} ms`],
        ["CPU Usage", `${cpuPercent}%`],
        ["RAM Usage", `${memPercent}%`],
        ["Storage Usage", `${diskInfo.percent}%`]
    ])

    .addTable([
        ["System", "Information"],
        ["NodeJS", process.version],
        ["CPU Core", String(cpus.length)]
    ])

    .addTable([
        ["Memory", "Value"],
        ["RAM Used", formatBytes(usedMem)],
        ["RAM Free", formatBytes(freeMem)],
        ["RAM Total", formatBytes(totalMem)]
    ])

    .addTable([
        ["Storage", "Value"],
        ["Disk Total", diskInfo.total],
        ["Disk Used", diskInfo.used],
        ["Disk Free", diskInfo.free]
    ])
    await ai.send(m.chat, {
        forwarded: true
    })
}
